title: Combining a machine-learning derived 4-lncRNA signature with AFP and TNM stages in predicting early recurrence of hepatocellular carcinoma.
summary: A machine-learning-derived four-lncRNA signature combined with AFP and TNM stage predicted early HCC recurrence and was externally validated; interpretation remains predictive rather than causal. External replication and prospective utility were not established.
